extraction_limitations: Atoms were extracted from the supplied PDF only; no external verification was performed.
Source anchors use page numbers and short excerpts rather than character offsets because the PDF text layer does not provide stable global offsets.

Most benchmark findings do not map naturally to clinical intervention/comparator fields; those atoms use method or qualitative-result kinds unless quantitative sufficiency context could be represented defensibly.
No dedicated funding or conflict-of-interest statement was found in the supplied text; those two atoms are explicitly marked extractor_inference and need human review.
The extraction is high-coverage but not exhaustive of every appendix prompt detail or every cell in all result tables.
